claims.quote: Our managed services team is exploring options. We have not identified a specific requirement or project owner. Please clarify what we need before arranging a discovery meeting.

raw_proposal.draft:
Hi [Customer Name],

Thank you for reaching out. We understand that your managed services team is currently exploring options and has not yet identified a specific requirement or project owner. To ensure we are aligned and can provide the most value, we would be happy to schedule a discovery meeting once we have a clearer understanding of your needs.

Could you please share more details about what you're looking to achieve? This will help us prepare for a productive discussion and tailor our approach to your specific goals.

Looking forward to your response.

Best regards,
[Your Name]
[Your Title]
Cedar Systems
